question: Bulgaria has joined the eurozone and adopted the euro as its official currency on January 1, 2026, becoming the ____________ member of the euro area.
solution:
The correct answer is __**21st.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Bulgaria joined the eurozone and adopted the euro as its official currency on January 1, 2026, becoming the 21st member of the euro area.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Bulgaria became the 21st country to adopt the euro as its official currency.**
 
• The euro and Bulgarian lev will circulate together throughout January 2026.
 
• From February 1, 2026, the euro will become Bulgaria’s sole legal tender.
 
• Eurozone Membership__ 
 __
 
• Bulgaria joined the European Union in 2007
 
• Euro adoption has been a long-term policy objective
 
• Marks deeper economic integration with the EU
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Eurozone__

 __
 
• The eurozone was officially launched on January 1, 1999
 
• Initially included 11 countries such as France, Germany, and Austria
 
• Uses the euro as the common currency
 
 
 
• Countries Yet to Adopt the Euro__
 __
 
• Sweden
 
• Poland
 
• Czech Republic
 
• Hungary
 
• Romania
 
• Denmark
 
 
 
• Currency Transition Mechanism__
 
 
• Dual circulation used to ensure smooth transition
 
• Allows citizens and businesses to adapt gradually
 
• Common practice during euro adoption
